statutory_framework.description: Same statewide MLUL framework as every NJ municipality in this project's set.

multifamily_specific.chapter: Chapter 213 (Multifamily Buildings) / Article VIII (R-3 Garden Group Zone)

local_code.note: Montclair has a dedicated multifamily zoning district ("R-3 Garden Group Zone") and a standalone Chapter 213 for multifamily-building standards (garbage/recycling screening, parking-area lighting, etc., confirmed live) -- more codified multifamily-specific detail than any other NJ town in this project's set. Minor site plans go through the Development Review Committee under Chapter 281's own standards, a lighter-weight path than full Planning Board review for larger projects.

triggering_conditions: parking lot new/expanded (separately fee-triggering, $1,500 per the code)
likely_permits: Site plan approval (minor via Development Review Committee, or major via Planning Board)
multifamily.hearing_likelihood: by-right in R-3 Garden Group Zone; variance-likely elsewhere
multifamily.hearing_likelihood_basis: R-3 is Montclair's own purpose-built multifamily district; outside it, multifamily in a town whose other residential zones are predominantly lower-density typically needs a use variance, the same general pattern as Princeton's AH-3 case.
multifamily.review_body: Development Review Committee (minor site plan) or Planning Board (major); Zoning Board of Adjustment (variance cases)

likely_permits: Minor site plan (Development Review Committee) or major (Planning Board), if triggered
small-commercial.hearing_likelihood: by-right (interior fit-out, minor site plan track) or variance-likely (new construction)
small-commercial.hearing_likelihood_basis: Montclair's own minor-site-plan track (Development Review Committee, Chapter 281) gives small commercial projects a lighter-weight path than full Planning Board review when the scope qualifies -- the same general new-construction-vs-fit-out split as the other NJ towns otherwise applies.
small-commercial.review_body: Development Review Committee (minor) or Planning Board (major, if triggered); otherwise Zoning only
